responsibility: Is the public NEON/AdvSIMD intrinsic header for Arm. It defines the NEON scalar and vector typedefs, tuple load/store aggregate types, endian-sensitive lane-index helpers, and the extensive inline intrinsic API that wraps backend NEON/VFP/BF16 builtins, exposing the architectural ACLE interface for SIMD arithmetic, conversions, table lookups, lane operations, and structured loads/stores when a hard-float ABI is available.
